title: Qualification truth and blockers
summary: Dev8 is source-reviewed and SHA-confirmed against the archived package but remains unqualified under ooRexx in the current environment. Earlier increments had separately reported interpreter assertions, but those are not evidence that dev8 passes. The Gopher sphere's JSON structure can be statically checked separately and must not be represented as full Gopher runtime activation. Blockers include graph mutation/time scopes, comparator versioning, provenance identity, malformed inputs and causal/bias authority separation.
invariants: Runtime test count for dev8: not established.

Before promotion: ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 rexxc + runtime suites, deterministic permutation fixtures, cycle and malformed relationship tests, historical as-of revisions, Unicode/source spans, limits and regression scenarios.
Before claiming a Gopher-activated sphere: run Sphere Editor validate/lint and Gopher profile context/open tests against a compatible installed version.
Package hash and GitHub commit are provenance, not proof of semantic correctness.
